description: Connect, add or set up an MCP server in a Replo project by its address or URL, so its tools can be used. Returns connected when the project already has it. Otherwise returns connectUrl: give the user that link; it signs them in to the server and connects it to the project in one click. Never ask for a token in chat. When they say they're done, call this again to confirm it's connected. Each integration has a skill named by its key: before using an integration's tools, read it (call skills with name "shopify", for example).

projectId.description: The project to add it to.

serverUrl.description: The MCP server's address, such as https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp. Public https only.

tag.description: The Integrations category it goes under, the one that best fits what its tools do.

name: add_mcp_server
title: Add an MCP server
